project.title: MyScoutee
project.readme:
# MyScoutee

120 tracked tasks; 113 have usage measurements. Current task allocation: **37,113,074,506 tokens**, **931.921 h**, **$28,005.06 Standard API equivalent**. Historical allocations include estimates; active time includes tool waits and is not human labor. Costs are not invoices. Unmeasured tasks are excluded, not zero.

[MSC-121](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/issues/159) is **Done**: microservices developer playground, Mongo StatefulSet, change-stream/cache freshness, Kubernetes status/SSE and blocking Redis telemetry follow-up. Final verified deployment: Helm 123. Broad feature QA and production qualification remain separate; MSC-122 extraction remains Todo.

MSC-121: 634,373,124 tokens, 30.466665 active h / 30.420657 allocated h, $889.43 API equivalent through 2026-10-09T15:12:03.126Z. The earlier template/licensing/components turns and October-10 publication work are excluded. MSC-120 retains its existing measurement boundary. MSC-113 is counted once.

[Restorable Project backup and measurement ledger](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap/tree/master/guides/project-history/myscoutee) · [Token heatmap](https://github.com/fssrepository/myscoutee-roadmap#measured-token-activity). The chart now ends October 9 with 42,358,256,064 combined tokens; latest account r lifetime is 40,111,683,863 through October 9. Account usage overlaps task usage and must not be added to it.

items.title: MSC-113: Add granular profile ratings and preserve fractional affinity
items.body:
Add profile-specific detailed ratings to the existing Home and Activities rating bars. The number/chevron button opens a same-width popup above the base bar without a backdrop; it sits immediately before Go/Save at the same height. Mobile floating controls follow the existing menu visibility rule.

Detail criteria use whole numbers. The base slider step is derived from the criterion count (1/N); its mean is preserved through the existing outbox, JSON, Mongo and affinity calculations on the original 1–10 scale. Successive base-slider ticks retain the group shape. Actor-owned detail snapshots accompany the score. Dating criteria and Home/Activities guide steps are translated in English and Hungarian; the configuration can supply different criteria for future profile types. Residential profiles themselves are not implemented by this task.

List and base badges retain fractional values, displayed to at most two decimals. The generated nginx frontend directory is ignored in the repository; tracked development artifacts remain locally hidden with skip-worktree until a deliberate snapshot update.

items.title: MSC-121: Package and qualify the microservices deployment playground
items.body:

- Sampled two-pod behavior, native session/contact flows, accepted-command recovery after worker termination, same-scenario stress comparison and documented limitations.
